review_builtin_meshes: review the DensePose builtin meshes catalog that registers SMPL and animal mesh data files
summarize_mesh_catalog: summarize the MeshInfo entries for smpl, chimp, cat, sheep, zebra, horse, giraffe, elephant, dog, cow, and bear
review_register_meshes: review the register_meshes call that registers all builtin meshes under the DENSEPOSE_MESHES_DIR base URL
review_meshinfo_entries: review the MeshInfo data objects each containing name, data, geodists, symmetry, and texcoords fields
summarize_mesh_variants: summarize the multiple mesh variants available for cat (5001, 7466) and dog (5002, 7466) species
